name: smwsprites-better-cheep-cheep
title: Better Cheep-Cheep
description:
changes
.EXGFX eliminates the discomfort of different colors.(If you using the original version, set it to yellow from the json file)
.Reverted the player's behavior when the fish is in the water to the default setting (which had a special behavior in the original). You can now spin jump off of a fish swimming in the surface and Yoshi can bounce off of it.
.Change swimming anime from frame-dependent to coordinate-dependent (this makes anime faster for fast individuals)
.The jumping height was changed from the pointer in the random number table to only a random number.
.Vertically moving fish always point in the direction of the player.
.The graphics are now always flipped vertically when defeated.
.Facing the player's direction when loading (including vertical)
.Add Sonikku's wet timer behavior.
.Can set the speed.
Requested by GooberFan75000
